literal_meaning: আনন্দ বা মজা দেখা (watching fun or enjoyment)
figurative_meaning_en: To derive pleasure from others' suffering or misfortune
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীর ব্যর্থতায় মজা দেখছে।
যুদ্ধের সময় অনেকে দূর থেকে মজা দেখে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is taking pleasure in his rival's failure.
During the conflict, many watched from afar enjoying the spectacle.
note: This idiom reflects a common human tendency observed in Bengali folklore and daily interactions.
